summary: Onboarding EXECUTE (Issue #15 M6): onboarding_execute carries out exactly the write contract of an owner-approved preflight in ONE transaction, reading the writes from the recorded preflight result (never from the caller), after re-checking every precondition against live data; verifies the cutoff / current trial balance, homeowner ledger, post-cutover activity and write counts in the database (any mismatch rolls everything back); records provenance on every row and an append-only execution record + write index (onboarding_executions, onboarding_execution_writes). Human only; one committed execution per batch; a retry writes nothing. Also onboarding_record_execution_failure and onboarding_execution_view. Applying it changes no rows. service_role only.

preflight.name: execution tables do not exist yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name IN ('onboarding_executions', 'onboarding_execution_writes')

preflight.name: 486 decisions function is in place
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_proc WHERE proname = 'onboarding_record_bridge_decisions'

preflight.name: accounting schema EXECUTE writes is present (superseded columns, ledger tenure + replacement, period table)
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND ((table_name = 'journal_entries' AND column_name IN ('superseded_at', 'superseded_reason', 'superseded_by_conversion', 'period_id')) OR (table_name = 'homeowner_transactions' AND column_name IN ('tenure_id', 'charge_category', 'raw_row_jsonb')) OR (table_name = 'transaction_upload_batches' AND column_name IN ('replaced_by_batch_id', 'reverted_reason', 'management_company_id')) OR (table_name = 'accounting_periods' AND column_name = 'status') OR (table_name = 'communities' AND column_name = 'gl_cutover_date'))

preflight.name: journal_entries accepts the source_module values EXECUTE writes (opening_entry, reversal, manual) and the superseded status
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid = 'journal_entries'::regclass AND contype = 'c' AND ((pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%source_module%' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%opening_entry%' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%reversal%' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%manual%') OR (pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%status%' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%superseded%' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) NOT LIKE '%superseded_at%'))

expected_changes: Creates table onboarding_executions (append-only; human actor; one committed execution per batch via a partial unique index; committed / failed shape checks) with its indexes and append-only trigger.
Creates table onboarding_execution_writes (append-only write index: table, row id, action, kind, key, before/after; deferred FK to the execution) with its index and append-only trigger.
Creates onboarding_execute, onboarding_record_execution_failure, onboarding_execution_view and the internal helpers onboarding_exec_post_je and onboarding_exec_tb_diff (EXECUTE to service_role only).
No row changes in any existing table. No accounting row is written until an owner executes an approved batch.

verify.name: execution tables present and append-only
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgname IN ('trg_onboarding_executions_append_only', 'trg_onboarding_execution_writes_append_only')

verify.name: one committed execution per batch
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_indexes WHERE indexname = 'uq_onboarding_executions_committed' AND indexdef LIKE '%committed%'

verify.name: execute functions present
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_proc WHERE proname IN ('onboarding_execute', 'onboarding_record_execution_failure', 'onboarding_execution_view', 'onboarding_exec_post_je', 'onboarding_exec_tb_diff')

verify.name: executions are human-only
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid = 'onboarding_executions'::regclass AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%actor_kind%human%'
